settings.driveConvention: Each row divided by its L1 norm. Normalized captures minus uniform tonic capture on the observed bands; missing bands contribute zero difference, not a recovered missing spectrum. Mapping rows to the ten seed identities is an engineering choice, not receptor biology.
settings.timeConvention: Dimensionless model time. Four units per queried patch; all patch banks are initialized at the tonic reference independently. No conversion to fly milliseconds, gamma bands or the motor source model.
